CHANNEL 1 (injected by pipeline — trust these numbers)

  3. Sector secondary factors (taxonomy checklist)
  4. Breadth / leadership inside the sector
  5. Flows / positioning / crowding for the sector ETF or peers

### a-sector-analysis-names-a-factor-as-a-relative-headwind-drag.md
## RULE
If a factor is named in the prose as a "headwind," "drag," "rotation away from," or "relative negative," it MUST receive a negative score in the corresponding component — or the prose must be deleted. No unscored named factors.
